plan: Store copied appointment choices and one canonical public session dictionary.
Validate every action completely before mutation, then apply state transitions.
Build deterministic screens from current session state and route one action through replaceable source/sink adapters.
mechanisms: Transactional action validation prevents malformed or invalid actions from corrupting session data.
A centralized screen builder guarantees exact keys, prompt selection, and conditional appointment choices.
Dependency-injected action_source and screen_sink support standard-library unittest fakes.
